create.name: Sachidananda Ashtanga Yoga Shala
create.bio:
Sachidananda Ashtanga Yoga Shala is a small, family-run shala in the Gokulam district of Mysuru, the city most closely tied to the Ashtanga Vinyasa method. M.V. Chidananda opened it in 2001. He started practising as a boy of eight, learning from B.N.S. Iyengar, a pupil of T. Krishnamacharya, and from his own father, the pranayama teacher S.V. Venkateshaiah, who still teaches at the shala. The school presents its work as a traditional, discipline-based path that joins posture, breath and the philosophy of yoga rather than exercise alone.

Daily practice is taught Mysore style, with each student moving through the Primary, Intermediate and Advanced series at their own pace and a led class each Monday; groups are kept to around fourteen. Alongside the asana room there are month-long classes in pranayama and in Patanjali's Yoga Sutras with Ganesh Bhat, plus introductions to Ayurveda and anatomy. Several times a year the shala runs a four-week, gurukula-style teacher training at 200 hours (Primary Series) and 300 hours (Intermediate Series), in which trainees end by teaching under Chidananda's supervision. All teaching is in person in Gokulam.

courses.title: Ashtanga Vinyasa Yoga Teacher Training Course (200 and 300 hour)
courses.description: A four-week residential-style training in Gokulam, six days a week, built on the gurukula model of learning directly from the teacher. Level 1 (200 hours) centres on the Primary Series and Level 2 (300 hours) on the Intermediate Series, with pranayama, Yoga Sutras, anatomy, Ayurveda and supervised teaching practice. The site lists further intakes from December 2026 through 2027.

courses.title: Mysore-style Ashtanga Vinyasa practice
courses.description: Daily self-paced classes from Monday to Saturday in which each student works through the set sequence with individual guidance from the teacher, plus a led class on Mondays. Newcomers learn the Primary Series first and move on once they are steady in it; a stay of at least a month is asked for Intermediate work.

courses.title: Pranayama classes with S.V. Venkateshaiah
courses.description: A weekday late-morning class in yogic breathing, including retention and alternate-nostril work, taught by the shala's senior teacher. The minimum stay is two weeks.

courses.title: Patanjali Yoga Sutras course
courses.description: A one-month evening class with Ganesh Bhat that reads through the four padas of the Yoga Sutras, from the aim of yoga and its eight limbs to liberation. It runs five evenings a week and also forms part of the teacher training.
